## Step 2 & 3 — Reference & Artifact Review
Loaded JTBD checklists for the two escalated perspectives from `perspectives.md`. Loaded ARRM routing matrix from `arrm-perspective-mapping.md`. Reviewed component markup, CSS, and interaction logic.

## Step 4 & 5 — Per-Perspective Checklists & Findings

### Perspective: Auditory Access (MEDIUM)
| Checklist Item | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `<video>` with speech has `<track kind="captions">` with valid `src` | PASS | Valid `.vtt` source present, `default` attribute set. |
| Media player controls keyboard-operable | PASS | Standard `<button>` and `<input type="range">` elements are natively keyboard accessible. |
| No audio auto-plays | PASS | `autoPlay={false}` explicitly set. |
| **Audio descriptions track format** | **FINDING** | Uses `.vtt` (text) instead of audio format. Will not play as AD. |
| Caption accuracy / Transcript speaker ID / AD coverage | **OPEN QUESTION** | Content-level verification required. |

**Finding 1**
```
**Finding:** Audio descriptions track is implemented as a WebVTT text file instead of an audio track. Players and AT will render it as text or ignore it, completely blocking auditory description access for blind users.
**WCAG:** 1.2.5 (Audio Description)
**Perspective:** Auditory Access
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: Content Author)
**Evidence:** MediaPlayer.jsx line ~38: `<track kind="descriptions" src="/video/tutorial-desc.vtt" srcLang="en" label="Audio descriptions" />`
**Fix:** Replace `.vtt` with a compatible audio track format (e.g., `.mp4`, `.aac`, or `.m4a`) embedded in the video container, or provide a separate downloadable audio file linked adjacent to the player controls.
```

### Perspective: Screen Reader & Semantic Structure (MEDIUM)
| Checklist Item | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Landmark regions present & correctly used | PASS | `<section aria-label="Video player">` wraps component; page shell provides `<main>`. |
| Heading hierarchy logical | PASS | `<h2>` inside section aligns with standard page outline. |
| DOM/source order matches visual reading order | PASS | Linear markup flow matches visual stack. |
| Form inputs have programmatic label association | PASS | `htmlFor`/`id` pairing on seek/volume sliders is correct. |
| Custom widgets use correct ARIA roles | PASS | `role="toolbar"` correctly groups interactive controls. |
| **Video poster accessible name** | **FINDING** | Poster image lacks `alt`. If informative, it's inaccessible; if decorative, should be explicitly hidden from AT. |
| **Dynamic time display live region** | **ENHANCEMENT** | `aria-live="off"` prevents AT from announcing playback progress updates. |

**Finding 2**
```
**Finding:** Video poster image lacks an alt attribute. If the poster conveys contextual or instructional information, it is inaccessible to screen readers. If decorative, it must be explicitly marked as such to prevent AT noise.
**WCAG:** 1.1.1 (Non-text Content)
**Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Severity:** MINOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: Visual Design)
**Evidence:** MediaPlayer.jsx line ~30: `<video ... poster="/img/tutorial-poster.jpg" ...>`
**Fix:** Add `alt=""` if the poster is purely decorative, or provide a concise descriptive `alt` attribute if it conveys information relevant to the tutorial content.
```

**Finding 3**
```
**Finding:** Dynamic time display uses `aria-live="off"`, preventing screen reader users from hearing playback progress updates without switching focus to the visual timer.
**WCAG:** 4.1.3 (Status Messages) / Enhances 1.3.1
**Perspective:** Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Severity:** ENHANCEMENT
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: UX Design)
**Evidence:** MediaPlayer.jsx line ~48: `<span className="time-display" aria-live="off">`
**Fix:** Change `aria-live` to `"polite"` so AT announces time updates periodically without interrupting the user's current task. Note: Requires runtime verification to ensure updates don't cause excessive verbosity during fast-forward/seek.
```

## Step 6 — Compile the summary

## Perspective Audit Summary

**Component/artifact reviewed:** MediaPlayer With Caption Support (`MediaPlayer.jsx` + associated CSS)
**Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Auditory Access, Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed):** Magnification & Reflow, Environmental Contrast, Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity, Keyboard & Motor Access, Cognitive & Neurodivergent

### Findings by Severity

| Severity | Count |
|---|---|
| CRITICAL | 0 |
| MAJOR | 1 |
| MINOR | 1 |
| ENHANCEMENT | 1 |

### Perspectives That Passed
- Magnification & Reflow (not reviewed)
- Environmental Contrast (not reviewed)
- Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity (not reviewed)
- Keyboard & Motor Access (not reviewed)
- Cognitive & Neurodivergent (not reviewed)
- Auditory Access (checklist items PASS except AD track format & content verification)
- Screen Reader & Semantic Structure (markup/ARIA structure PASS except poster alt & live region enhancement)

### Perspectives With Findings — Grouped by ARRM Role

**Front-End Dev**
- Audio descriptions track uses invalid WebVTT format instead of audio — Auditory Access — MAJOR — 1.2.5
- Video poster image lacks `alt` attribute — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — MINOR — 1.1.1
- Dynamic time display uses `aria-live="off"` blocking AT progress updates — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — ENHANCEMENT — 4.1.3

**Content Author**
- Caption accuracy, timing, and transcript speaker identification require editorial review — Auditory Access — MINOR (content flag) — 1.2.2 / 1.2.1

**Visual Design**
- Poster image semantic role (decorative vs informative) requires design/content alignment — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — MINOR — 1.1.1

### Open Questions Requiring Human Verification
- Caption accuracy and sync timing against the video audio track.
- Transcript section includes speaker identification for all distinct voices.
- Audio descriptions cover all critical visual-only information in the tutorial.
- Runtime verification of `aria-live="polite"` update frequency to ensure it doesn't overwhelm AT users during seek operations.

### Recommended Next Step
**REVISE** — Address the MAJOR finding (invalid AD track format) and MINOR findings (poster alt, live region enhancement) before shipping. Content-level flags require editorial sign-off. No CRITICAL blockers present; component architecture is solid and keyboard/contrast/motion foundations are compliant.
